result.rationale: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the full Zod safeParse envelope (`return refreshTokenResponse;`), and googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts now does `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema); ... prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, whereas before it was `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)`. So the persisted key becomes `{ success, data }` instead of the credentials, breaking access_token/refresh_token access on every subsequent read. Verified from the diff.

judged_text: Google Calendar persists the Zod safeParse envelope as the credential key: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the full { success, data } envelope but googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts assigns it directly to key and writes it to the DB, so after any routine token refresh key.access_token and key.refresh_token are undefined and every Google Calendar operation and all future refreshes fail permanently for that user
